### Thoughts about Freedom

True freedom is not the ability to do whatever one wants, but the power to become what God intended us to be. In the Orthodox tradition, freedom is deeply linked to our restoration in Christ.

#### Freedom and Choice

Man was created with free will, but this will was darkened by the Fall. Christ came to restore our true freedom by conquering the forces of sin and death that held us captive. 'If the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.'

#### The Limit of Human Freedom

Human freedom is not absolute; it is finite and exists within the context of God's sovereign providence. We are free to choose our path, but we are not free from the consequences of our choices. True freedom is found in alignment with the Divine Will, where the human person reaches their full potential.
